body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0025 {
  meta:
    author = "DaC"
    description = "User added to security group (EventCode 4728) - Detects group membership additions (EventCode 4728). On this event TargetUserName is the GROUP and MemberName/MemberSid identify the member added; SubjectUserName is the actor."
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0025"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1098"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "4728"
    ($e.target.user.user_display_name != "" or $e.target.user.windows_sid != "")
    $user = $e.principal.user.userid
    $name = $e.principal.hostname

  match:
    $user, $name over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $members = array_distinct($e.target.user.user_display_name)
    $member_sids = array_distinct($e.target.user.windows_sid)
    $groups = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)

  condition:
    $e
}
